title: Captain America: Civil War — The Complete Main Story
description: A connected recap of the 2016 Civil War film: Lagos, the Accords, Bucky’s pursuit, both airport teams and the final Siberian confrontation. The late recording is revealed in the final act, not the hook.
hook: The Avengers win their battles. So why are they about to tear each other apart?
payoff: Black Panther chooses justice over revenge and arrests Zemo. Steve frees his imprisoned friends. Bucky enters cryogenic sleep in Wakanda until his brainwashing can be removed.

units.speaker: Host
units.text: The Avengers win their battles. So why are they about to tear each other apart?

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Wanda redirects an explosion in Lagos, killing civilians. Governments demand control of the Avengers through the Sokovia Accords.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Tony feels responsible for Sokovia and agrees. Steve fears political control. After Peggy's funeral, he follows his own conscience.
units.onscreen: TONY AND STEVE CHOOSE DIFFERENT SIDES
units.visual_query: TONY AND STEVE CHOOSE DIFFERENT SIDES

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Then a bombing kills Wakanda's king, and Bucky is blamed. His son, Black Panther, wants revenge. Steve finds Bucky first.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: A fake psychiatrist triggers Bucky's brainwashing. Steve stops his helicopter escape. Once himself again, Bucky reveals five more Winter Soldiers hidden in Siberia.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Clint frees Wanda. Sharon returns Steve's gear. Steve gathers his allies, but Tony intercepts them at the airport. Spider-Man steals Steve's shield; Ant-Man goes giant.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Natasha lets Steve and Bucky escape, then goes on the run. Vision accidentally shoots down Rhodey, leaving him paralyzed. Steve's other allies are sent to the Raft prison.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Tony discovers Bucky was framed and follows them. In Siberia, they find the other soldiers already dead. Someone has led them into a different trap.
units.onscreen: THE THREAT IS NOT WHAT THEY EXPECTED
units.visual_query: THE THREAT IS NOT WHAT THEY EXPECTED

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: The bomber, Zemo, lost his family in Sokovia. He plays a recording: a brainwashed Bucky murdered Tony's parents. Steve knew about the murder.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Tony attacks Bucky. Steve won't abandon his friend. Tony blasts off Bucky's metal arm; Steve disables the armor, then leaves his shield behind.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Black Panther stops Zemo's suicide and arrests him. Steve frees his friends. Tony helps Rhodey walk again. Bucky sleeps in Wakanda while they work to remove his brainwashing.
units.onscreen: A BROKEN TEAM. A WAY FORWARD.
units.visual_query: A BROKEN TEAM. A WAY FORWARD.

units.speaker: Host
units.text: Steve sends Tony an apology and a phone. Their friendship is broken, but if Tony ever needs him, Steve will answer. For more stories like this, subscribe.
